object: Fee Opt-In as an experiment write-up card: problem, hypothesis, variants, metrics, result and the next test, opening on the result
desc: A short path through Allen Kang's work: an A/B test that took fee opt-in from 75% to 92%, payments design that cut support tickets, motion with rules, and apps that already run.
lede: I’m Allen, a senior product designer in Toronto, glad to work remote. Eight years designing, the last five on payments: checkout fees, split transactions, one design system for three merged products. My favourite result came from pausing a launch that already looked like a win. I prototype in code with AI tools like Cursor and Claude Code, and I care how things move.
caption: Step through the write-up. Every figure is from the real test; the small controls under Variants are recreations.
h1: The slider variant took fee opt-in to 92%, with conversion holding steady.
contact: I’m glad to walk through the full write-up, including the variants that lost.
